"Unkalukkul irukkum talaimaittuvattai valarttetukka" by John C. Maxwell offers insightful guidance on developing leadership qualities and harnessing your potential. This book reveals that true leadership goes beyond mere influence, emphasizing that leadership is about inspiring others and creating meaningful change. Maxwell outlines essential leadership traits and distinguishes between management and leadership, illustrating how motivating others to excel is key to effective leadership. Whether you're at the beginning of your leadership journey or looking to enhance your skills, this book provides practical advice to help you grow and inspire others with dedication and vision.
